plugins.description: An agent swarm, Oracle, Manager, Lead, Coder, and an optional Driver, that takes a PRD to built, tested, reviewed code through enforced reviews, a shared ledger, and a scoring rubric. Runs in Claude Code only (CLI, desktop, or IDE) on Windows or macOS: every role is a local background session with its own hooks and a per-repo ledger server, so claude.ai and Cowork cannot run it.
